BEFORE YOU JUMP IN

A few
good questions.

✳
What is ReplyVibe?+

ReplyVibe is a Chrome extension that helps you write AI-powered replies on X. Choose your tone, review the suggestion, and make it your own.

How many free replies do I get?+

You get 7 free reply variations per account, as a one-time lifetime allowance. Free includes 4 basic tones and 1 variation per generation. There is no daily reset.

What comes with Pro?+

Pro is $9 per month and includes 3,000 individual reply variations per billing period, all 10 tones, up to 3 variations per generation, custom voice, and saved preferences. Usage resets after verified successful renewal.

Does ReplyVibe post for me?+

You decide what to share. Review and edit your reply, then copy or insert it into X before posting.

Can I install it yet?+

ReplyVibe is currently in Chrome Web Store review. The installation link will be available here after approval.
